claude_only.name: Which governed external registry identifiers resolve to this facility, and what is their precedence for cross-system reconciliation?
Is the identifier persistent and never reused after the facility is decommissioned, merged into another facility or split?
What deduplication and match-confidence rule applies when two source systems report what may be the same physical facility?
What is the preferred facility name, in which language and script, and which authority may change it?
Which alternate, historical, legal and signage names apply, and over what validity periods?
What reference designation is assigned to the facility, and in which aspect structure is it expressed?
Where a downstream system keys on name rather than identifier, what compensating control prevents mis-resolution?
What is the facility's primary function code, in which classification scheme and version, and as of what date?
Which secondary uses coexist at this facility and what share of floor area or activity does each represent?
Which classification is authoritative for regulatory reporting, and which is authoritative for benchmarking and portfolio analysis?
What change of use triggers reclassification, and what revaluation, permitting or benchmarking consequences follow?
Which code occupancy group or groups apply, under which code edition adopted by which jurisdiction?
Where multiple occupancies coexist, is the facility treated as separated, non-separated or accessory, and where are the separation boundaries?
What is the highest hazard classification present, and which stored or processed materials drive it?
Which authority having jurisdiction issued the occupancy determination and what evidence records it?
Which geometric representations exist for the facility, and which one is authoritative for regulatory and emergency use?
In which coordinate reference system and vertical datum is the geometry expressed, and what is its stated horizontal and vertical accuracy?
At what level of detail is the geometry held, and what was the capture method and capture date?
Is the facility placed absolutely or relatively to a site or parent facility, and what happens to the placement if the parent moves or is re-surveyed?
Which addresses are recorded for the facility and what role does each play (postal, regulatory reporting, emergency response, service delivery)?
Which administrative and jurisdictional units contain the facility, at which levels, and on what date were they determined?
Does the facility straddle any jurisdictional, tribal, utility or emergency-response boundary, and how is the split resolved for reporting?
Which site or sites contain this facility, and is the containment exclusive for the period asserted?
If no site is recorded, what justifies treating the facility as the outermost spatial container, and what supplies its georeference?
When the containing site is subdivided, merged or re-tenured, does the facility identifier persist and what event records the change?
Which decomposition convention governs the facility breakdown, and why was it chosen over the alternatives?
Which buildings and structures are members of this facility, and over what validity period is each membership asserted?
How are shared, common or jointly used parts handled where membership is not exclusive?
How deep does the facility breakdown go before responsibility passes to the Building or Space model?
Which engineered systems serve this facility, and what reference designation and aspect structure identifies each?
Which systems cross the facility boundary to a site-level or external utility, and where is the demarcation point?
What key links facility records to the component asset register, and what proportion of installed assets is covered?
How is an asset that is relocated between facilities recorded, and which record retains its maintenance history?
What is the facility's current lifecycle phase and operational status, on which code list, and since when?
Which milestone events have occurred, and what are the event time and the observation or recording time for each?
What evidence closes construction handover and opens operation, and who accepts it?
Which terminal states exist (mothballed, disposed, demolished), and which obligations survive each of them?
What is the current condition measure, by which assessment method, and as of what assessment date?
What design service life was specified and what remaining service life is now estimated, on what basis?
What is the deferred maintenance and repair liability, in which currency and price base, and as of when?
How often must condition be reassessed, who is competent to do it, and what happens when the cadence is missed?
What are this record version's validity bounds, and how do they differ from the facility's real-world validity period?
For each time-bearing attribute, are event time, observation time and ingestion time recorded separately with explicit offsets?
How is a correction of an erroneous earlier value distinguished from a record of a real-world change?
What rule resolves overlapping or conflicting versions of the same facility record?
What type of legal interest is held in the facility, by which party, and over what term?
Which organisation has custody and control of the facility for operational purposes, if different from the title holder?
Which encumbrances, easements, covenants or lease conditions constrain how the facility may be used or altered?
What process records a change of ownership or interest, and what evidence must accompany it?
Which organisation is the demand organisation for this facility and which is the facility-management service provider?
What scope of services is delegated, under which agreement, and what is expressly retained by the demand organisation?
Who is the named accountable person or role for statutory duties at this facility, and how is competence evidenced?
How is a change of operator or service provider recorded, and what information must transfer with it?
Which regulatory programmes apply to this facility, which regulator is competent for each, and what programme identifier has each issued?
Which permits and authorisations are currently in force, with what validity dates and what operating conditions?
Which statutory inspections and certifications are required, and what are the last completion and next due dates for each?
Which nonconformities are open, what corrective action is committed, and by when must it complete?
What periodic reporting obligations follow from each programme interest, and at what cadence?
What security level has been assessed for this facility, and what score did each determination factor contribute?
Which protective measures are required at this level, which are implemented, and which deviations have been accepted by whom?
Is the facility designated critical infrastructure, under which sector and by which authority?
When was the security assessment performed, when is reassessment due, and what event forces an early reassessment?
Which attributes are withheld, generalised or precision-reduced in public releases, and on what legal basis is each?
What sensitivity marking applies to each bundle, layer, finding and artifact of this facility record?
Who may grant an access exception, for what duration, and under what justification?
What must be logged when restricted facility attributes are read, exported or shared with an external party?
Which area measures are recorded, under which measurement standard, and as of what date?
What is the design capacity, what is actual utilisation, and by what formula is utilisation derived?
What are the peak and typical occupant populations by category, how are they counted and how current is the count?
What is the operating schedule, including weekly operating hours and seasonal or shift variation?
How are shared and common areas apportioned across member buildings and tenants, and does the total reconcile?
Which energy, water and emissions metrics are tracked, over what reporting period, and in what units?
Which normalisation and benchmark reference is applied, and against which comparison population?
Does the metering boundary coincide with the facility boundary, and what is included or excluded?
What share of reported consumption is metered versus estimated, and what estimation method was used?
How are restatements of previously published performance figures identified, justified and propagated?
Which maintenance strategy applies to each facility system, and what evidence justifies the choice?
Which planned maintenance tasks and frequencies are defined, and from which source were they derived?
How do work orders resolve back to facility, system and component, and what happens when the component is unknown?
What is the maintenance backlog, how is it aged, and what threshold escalates it to a condition or risk finding?
What criticality or mission-dependency rating does the facility carry, derived by which method and reviewed when?
Which natural and human-caused hazards is the facility exposed to, and on what likelihood and severity basis is each assessed?
What redundancy, alternate-facility or degraded-mode arrangements exist if the facility becomes unavailable?
When were the risk assessment and the continuity plan last reviewed and exercised, and what did the exercise find?
Which operational trigger events require an information exchange, to whom, and within what deadline?
What constitutes the accepted asset information model for this facility, and where is its authoritative copy held?
How are information acceptance and rejection recorded, and what happens to rejected deliverables?
For each attribute, which source system supplied the value, when was it observed and when was it ingested?
What precedence rule resolves conflicting values for the same attribute from different sources?
Which validation rules must a facility record pass before publication, and which are blocking versus advisory?
What confidence or quality measure accompanies matched, derived or estimated values, and how is it computed?
Which external standards is this model aligned to, at what version, and in which direction does each mapping run?
Which concepts cannot be expressed faithfully in a given target, and what is lost or approximated?
What evidence would be required before claiming conformance rather than alignment to any target standard?
How is alignment breakage detected when a target standard is revised, and who is accountable for repair?
Which retention schedule and item governs each class of facility record, and what is the disposition trigger and period?
Which facility records are permanent or must be offered for archival transfer, and on what criterion?
Which records must be retained for the life of the structure plus a defined period, and how is that end date computed?
How is destruction authorised and evidenced, and what residual metadata survives it?
What is the canonical logical payload of a facility record, independent of document, graph, relational or document-database projection?
How are artifacts packaged, integrity-checked and referenced from the facility record?
How are partial updates expressed, ordered and validated against the canonical payload?
What agent bootstrap contract must accompany any store or interface exposing this model?

grok_only.name: What governed IRI, IFC GlobalId, FHIR identifier or Dimension UUID or ULID is assigned, and which of these is canonical inside this Dimension?
Which program-system or permit identifiers are linked to this facility and must not be treated as the master facility key?
Has this identifier been merged, split or superseded, and what surviving master identifier should agents use?
What is the current public or commercial name of the facility as used on signs, invoices or the master registry?
What aliases, former names or long names are known, including names used after ownership change?
Which name is canonical for matching and public display, and which names are known to be ambiguous or parent-organization names?
What facility type or physical form is asserted, in which classification scheme, and is it a building, civil facility, mixed complex or other?
What operational function or service-delivery role does the facility perform for the demand organization?
Should a more specific IFC or local subtype be used instead of generic facility, and what agreed ObjectType is used if not?
Do EPA type, IFC subtype and FHIR type or physicalType conflict for this facility, and which type is used for which process?
What NAICS or SIC codes classify the industrial activity of this facility, which is primary, and from which program system were they taken?
What occupancy or use classification and division apply under the adopted building code, and to which portion of the facility?
Is the facility mixed occupancy or mixed use, and how are portions classified and authorized separately?
Which edition of the building or occupancy code was in force when the current occupancy was authorized?
What is the physical location address of the main entrance or front door, including locality, region, postal code and country?
Which administrative, tribal, regional or building-code jurisdictions apply to this facility?
Is this address the containing site, the facility entrance, a mailing address, or a parent-organization address, and how was that distinguished?
What land-title, cadastral or parcel references locate the facility without making this model the legal parcel register?
What are the authoritative latitude, longitude and optional elevation or altitude, and in which geodetic datum?
What collection method, geometric type, reference point and horizontal accuracy apply to the coordinate, and is it a best-pick or ZIP centroid approximation?
When was the coordinate observed or surveyed, and when was it ingested or last refreshed in the registry?
Is facility placement absolute in a world CRS, relative to a site, or relative to a facility complex, and which CRS or map conversion is used?
Which Site contains this facility, or is the facility the outermost spatial container with no site recorded?
Which buildings, structures or facility parts does this facility contain, and is the relation spatial containment or operational aggregation?
Is this facility a complex, an element or a part, and if it nests under another facility what are the composition-type constraints?
Does the operational facility span multiple sites, share a site with other facilities, or interfere spatially with another facility?
Is this a building-oriented facility, a civil or infrastructure facility, or a mixed campus, and which IFC or local subtype applies?
Is the facility fixed, mobile or relocatable, and if mobile what is the current position versus the home base?
Does the candidate fail the facility test because it is a single asset, an unbuilt asset, a kind classifier, or a space or room?
Who is the legal owner of the facility or of the land it occupies, and is ownership federal, public, private or mixed?
Which party is the demand organization, which is the FM organization or operator, and is service delivery in-house, outsourced or co-sourced?
What is the effective interval of each owner, operator or demand-organization role, and what happens to the AIM on transfer?
Which organizations and persons are affiliated with the facility, in what role, and what are their contacts and mailing addresses?
Is the facility owned, leased or otherwise occupied, and what are the agreement type, identifier, commencement, termination, options and restrictions?
Has due diligence been completed for a sale, lease or appointment, and what gaps remain in physical, functional, financial or environmental evidence?
Has a certificate of occupancy or equivalent occupancy authorization been issued for this facility or a described portion, and by which AHJ?
What use, occupancy classification, construction type, code edition and design occupant load does the certificate authorize?
Is occupancy authorized in phases or for only a portion of the facility, and what is still prohibited?
When was the certificate issued or occupancy authorized, and when was that fact observed or ingested into this model?
What is the current operational status of the facility, and is it in-service, suspended, inactive, mothballed or not yet commissioned?
Has commissioning, handover and transfer from the project information model to the asset information model been completed?
Do registry, BIM, healthcare-location and environmental-program statuses agree, and which status is used for which operating process?
What trigger event occurred or is scheduled, of what type, and is it planned, unplanned or an ownership acquisition?
What AIM, status, occupancy or composition updates does this trigger event require, and which appointed party will produce them?
What is the event time, and what is the observation or ingestion time of the record?
Is a change of occupancy or use proposed or complete, and has the AHJ issued a new occupancy authorization?
Is the facility being renovated, adaptively reused, mothballed, decommissioned, deconstructed or demolished, and what regulated-material constraints apply?
Have facility services been demobilized, and do environmental or safety program interests remain after operations cease?
Which facility services are delivered at this facility, by which provider, and are they in-house, outsourced or co-sourced?
What service-level requirements and measurement conditions apply at this facility, and where is the SLA referenced?
Are services mobilized, in steady operation, or being demobilized, and what resources and data were established at start-up?
Which mechanical, electrical, fire, transport or other systems service this facility as a spatial container?
Are servicing systems contained in this facility, referenced from another spatial structure, or spanning several facilities?
What commissioning or performance evidence shows that servicing systems meet the facility's required functions?
What design occupant load, typical occupancy number and peak occupancy apply, and over what occupancy time per day?
What are the usual hours of operation, including days of week and availability exceptions?
Is the facility publicly accessible, and is it designated handicap accessible at the facility aggregate level?
What service-life period and performance requirements apply to the facility or its major parts?
Has a post-occupancy or implementation evaluation been completed, when, and what outcomes were recorded?
Which key performance indicators are governed at facility level, including any indoor environmental quality measures, and what is the current result?
Which environmental or regulatory program interests apply to this facility, under which statute, and in which program system?
What permits or program authorizations are in force, expired or pending, and what are their identifiers and effective intervals?
Are all known program records linked to the same master facility identifier, or are split or duplicate facility records still open?
What is the current reported compliance status by statute, and as of which refresh date?
When did the last compliance monitoring activity occur, of what type, and is the date an on-site inspection or an evaluation completion date?
Is the reported violation or noncompliance an alleged status used for tracking, or a final adjudication, and what caveats apply?
What fire-risk, sprinkler, exit and related life-safety assertions are made at facility scale, and where is detailed design held?
What named risks are assessed for the facility, with unmitigated and mitigated likelihood, consequence and significance?
What emergency-preparedness capability is asserted, and what evidence supports it?
What security or high-security zones exist, what access controls apply, and which parties are authorized?
Which facility information is subject to security-minded handling, and what classification or redaction rules apply?
Who may read or update location, occupancy, system or risk fields, and what audit is required?
Where is the asset information model for this facility held, in which CDE or linked enterprise systems, and what is its acceptance status?
Was the AIM transferred when ownership or operatorship changed, and what gaps remain?
Who or what application last created or changed this facility information object, and when?
Which source system is authoritative for which fields, and when was each source last refreshed?
What documented information must be controlled for this facility, in what medium, and for what purpose?
What is the match or merge status of this facility record, including candidate duplicates and steward decisions?
Which required identity, location or classification fields are missing, non-standard or conflicting across sources?
Is the published location a surveyed point, a best-pick, or an approximation such as a ZIP centroid?
What retention, archival and deletion rules apply to the facility record, AIM containers and occupancy certificates, and who may authorize deletion?
What is the default access rule for this facility, which scopes are separately controlled, and which security or privacy exceptions apply?
Which external schemas is this facility aligned to, and which known semantic conflicts are in force for this instance?
